description: Upload an image (JPG, PNG, WebP or SVG, up to 10 MB) from a public URL to the connected Templated account. Use this to keep an image in the account's assets for templates and renders. Returns the upload; its 'path' is the URL to use as image_url. API reference: https://templated.io/docs

url.description: Public URL of the image to upload

name: create_upload
